DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL server host (Railway injected)

PG_PORT.description: Port for the PostgreSQL server connection (default: 5432)

PG_DATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name for Keycloak (default: keycloak)

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for the PostgreSQL user account used by Keycloak

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial master realm admin username (default: admin)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial master realm admin password; use Admin UI to change later

KC_PROXY.description: Reverse proxy mode: edge (Railway), passthrough, reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable plain HTTP listener; false for Railway HTTPS-only deployments

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL users access Keycloak at; must match your domain

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
